_comment: Four gloomgrit to one glowstone dust. The ratio is HERE and not in the furnace because
`AbstractCookingRecipe extends SingleItemRecipe` -- one ingredient, one item consumed per operation --
so no smelting recipe can eat four of anything. Crafting can eat any number, which makes this the place
for the arithmetic and leaves the furnace to be the slow gate.
Shapeless: the grit and the dust are being mixed, and a shape would imply the arrangement mattered.
